visualCharacteristics.purpose: Anniversary photo mosaic with an overlay teaser panel, logo and colour tiles
visualCharacteristics.layout: Main tile 3/4 width (photo with text panel, or video) beside a right column with small logo / colour tiles on top and a tall photo below; stacked on mobile
notable: Tile with text gets a translucent panel and a whole-tile link

contentPattern.structure: One row per tile in reading order, first row the main tile: picture + text, picture only, empty, or video link + poster

usage: Use for campaign / anniversary entry points combining photos, a logo and one teaser.
reuseGuidance: Built for 3-4 tiles; use cards or tiles for regular teaser grids.
